《Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars》is a documentary series streaming on Apple TV that tells the story of chasing the highest honour in the culinary world, and it has now made a powerful return. Here are the details.

《Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars》Season 2 returns with force

《Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars》returns for its second season of eight brand-new episodes less than a year after the debut of the first season, continuing to tell the story of restaurants around the world fighting for, maintaining, or adding to their Michelin stars.

The series is hosted by food and travel expert Jesse Burgess, with Gordon Ramsay and Studio Ramsay Global serving as executive producers, documenting the relentless efforts of restaurants, chefs and their teams as they fight for and defend the highest honour in the culinary world.

Apple announced just days ago that the new season will visit a total of 16 restaurants across Europe, the United States and Brazil, each at a different stage in the pursuit of stars.

After the first two episodes premiere today, new episodes will be released every Friday until 6 November.
